$comment: Data for /ops/audit. Records what each issue is FOR — never whether it is open. State is volatile and belongs to GitHub; asserting it here would create the exact rot half these issues are about. Add an entry when an audit surfaces work; do not edit entries to mark them done.

audits.title: Fleet audit — gates that fire from nothing, records that aren't true
audits.verdict: Every build that runs is green. The weakness is uniform and it is not code quality: excellent gates that nothing triggers, and records nobody verifies. Six of these fifteen are one of those two problems. check-sync-map and figma:staging-inventory --check already solve it correctly by re-deriving instead of trusting — that pattern just has not spread.

themes.name: Broken right now
themes.summary: Real defects with the fix already measured.

issues.title: StackedCardRail ships broken CSS under SSR
issues.accomplishes: React escapes the quotes in its inline <style>, so five selectors arrive as " and do nothing until hydration. Proven with React's own renderer. Bites any Next.js App Router consumer — which #268 shipped 'use client' specifically to support. One line.

issues.title: Three rendered defects, patches written and verified
issues.accomplishes: Table (a story fixture pins 240px against 234px of content — the primitive is innocent), Breadcrumb (the gate is wrong, not the component), tokenizer (32 findings are really 5 once the WCAG spacing exception is measured). All three diagnoses survived adversarial verification.

issues.title: Type scale and the small-text token bypass
issues.accomplishes: Separates three complaints that felt like one. The ramp has a 1.5x canyon at 48→72 then a near-duplicate at 72→80. Small text bypasses the eyebrow token entirely — components use Tailwind's tracking-wide (0.025em) where the token says 0.08em. And there is no golden ratio for UI type: shipped systems use two regimes, not one.

themes.name: Records that assert things that are not true
themes.summary: The theme of the day. A confident summary that happens to be wrong is worse than no summary.

issues.title: status.json claims 56 play() functions that do not exist
issues.accomplishes: There are zero. The figure came from grepping `play:`, which matches `display:` in inline styles. It has been directing sessions at work that does not exist. Proposes moving derived counts into generated artifacts a gate can check.

issues.title: HdsSystemDocLayout's description claims a layout it does not have
issues.accomplishes: The manifest calls it a three-column doc layout with sidebar and nav. It renders a single centred column and takes two props, so there is nowhere to pass a sidebar. Agents are told to trust the manifest over prose.

issues.title: The dashboard cannot tell when status.json is stale
issues.accomplishes: Derivation shipped — statusFreshness now rides on every ProjectStatus, measured against the repo's real latest commit rather than a deploy timestamp. Left open because two DoD items are unmet and closing it would hide them.

issues.title: Render statusFreshness on /ops
issues.accomplishes: The data exists and nothing shows it. Deferred because StandingPage is claimed on the session board — and that claim may itself be stale, which is worth resolving first.

themes.name: Gates and hygiene
themes.summary: Mostly: a check exists and nothing fires it, or fires it wrongly.

issues.title: check-rendered-geometry is non-deterministic on animated components
issues.accomplishes: Fired once in three identical runs on an animating spinner. A gate that fires at random trains people to re-run it, and a gate people re-run blocks nothing.

issues.title: docs/sync-map.json is committed generated output with no drift gate
issues.accomplishes: Either gate it or gitignore it — the repo should do one thing for generated artifacts, not two. Both review axes flagged it independently.

issues.title: The published library ships the documentation corpus
issues.accomplishes: component-api.json is ~45% of the main bundle and is documentation. Splitting it puts the bundle below main's current size and lets the budget come down rather than ratchet up.

issues.title: Dead island: componentPreviewRegistry and its two importers
issues.accomplishes: knip flags all three; they reference each other and nothing else. Its hand-written props table covers 30 of 139 components and a third of its entries name components that no longer exist — the cautionary tale for any docs rebuild that asks a human to author example props.

issues.title: Nothing counts down to decide_by
issues.accomplishes: The Decision template collects a default and a date so silence resolves instead of blocking. Nothing surfaces the date, so silence just stalls. blocking:Yes must never auto-default.

issues.title: Docs shell: left rail, content, right rail
issues.accomplishes: A restoration, not a new design — the previous HDS site already had it. Records the Fumadocs mechanism: named grid areas, rail widths defaulting to 0, composing sticky offsets, and a TOC that becomes a popover rather than vanishing.

issues.title: One board for every live surface
issues.accomplishes: /api/projects already returns state, url and commit. Three gaps: it shows the hashed per-deploy URL instead of the stable alias, it can only ever see Vercel, and READY is not the same as live.

issues.title: Consignment v1 — sell guest artists without becoming a marketplace
issues.accomplishes: Adrian stays merchant of record, so no Stripe Connect, no auth, no database — and ordinary bookkeeping instead of marketplace-facilitator tax and 1099-K. Tests the demand in a weekend rather than a quarter.
